basicDetails.schemeName: Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana

children.text: Female domestic workers, Contract workers and Hamal to be registered with the Board.
Benefits from this scheme are not available to individuals who are already receiving benefits from another comparable scheme offered by the State Government.
The age limit for the scheme should be above 18.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Female domestic workers, Contract workers and Hamal to be registered with the Board.
1. Benefits from this scheme are not available to individuals who are already receiving benefits from another comparable scheme offered by the State Government.
1. The age limit for the scheme should be above 18.

children.text: The scheme provides the following benefits:
Skill development training in below identified trades
House Hold (Making Badi, Papad, Pickle Etc.)
Family empowerment activities such as health education, financial literacy, and entrepreneurship training

schemeContent.benefits_md:
The scheme provides the following benefits:

1. Skill development training in below identified trades 

   1. Beautician (Beautician)
   1. Nutritionist (Nutrition)
   1. Dietitian
   1. Cooking
   1. Hospitality
   1. House Hold (Making Badi, Papad, Pickle Etc.)
   1. Nursing
   1. Tailoring

1. Financial assistance for training
1. Family empowerment activities such as health education, financial literacy, and entrepreneurship training
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March  2015. The main objective of the scheme to provide skill development training and family empowerment to women workers, contract workers, porters, and domestic workers.
